summary: Bail conditions for foreigners; Civil Authority permission required under Foreigners Act, 1946 Rule 5(1)(b) to depart India; no mandating impleadment of Registration Officer in bail applications; court shall direct State/prosecuting agency to notify Registration Officer upon bail grant; unnecessary delay avoidance in foreigner bail hearings; separate powers under Act vs bail jurisdiction upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of as per judgment dated 08-07-2024; directions issued for communication of bail orders to Registration Officers.
